ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 感谢一直以来支持我们的各位粉丝

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
……你们两个还是初中生，
在外面就不要跟粉丝接触了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
大家好，初次见面！
我是『La La La La Girls』的队长歌美，还有——

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
本人歌美，
决定退出『La La La La Girls』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 今天有好消息要告诉大家

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 今天，有件事情要向各位报告

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我觉得现在这样就挺好的

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 不好意思，我们现在正在赶路
